description: This PHP source file defines the InstanceAPI class, which handles REST API requests for managing instance data (such as organization name, country, language, and timezone) during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for handling installation instance data requests, including POST for storing data and GET for retrieving current data.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to store installation instance data such as organization name, country, language, and timezone, with validation and error responses.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current installation instance data, including organization name, country, language, and timezone.
